biography.plain_text: Ruth Nash Bliss was an American heiress to the fortune created by Nash Motors founder Charles W. Nash. Born in Flint, Michigan, she graduated from the National Seminary in Washington. After living in Grosse Pointe, she settled in Palm Beach in 1975, where she remained until her death at 105.

long_biography.plain_text:
Ruth Nash Bliss married into the working circle of her father's automobile business. Her husband, Chester Hascall Bliss, had returned from wartime aviation service and held a senior sales position at Nash when they married at her parents' Kenosha home in 1919. The couple left on an extended motor tour of the eastern United States before making their home in Kenosha.

The family's wealth reached her through bequests from both parents. Her mother, Jessie, left the residue of her estate to Ruth and her sister after providing for relatives and employees. Her father's estate subsequently established trusts for the two daughters.
